text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, they've reached the final straight!! 
Every Umamusume is launching into their 
final sprint!!

text_block_list.name: Ruck & Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Win! Today, right here, against Ai-san, I 
definitely will...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I won't... lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye! It's Almond Eye!! Almond Eye 
takes the lead!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye crosses the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent victory!!! Claiming victory 
in this race of the century is Almond 
Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I won...! I really did...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on the back-to-back wins, Almond 
Eye!! She really is just the absolute 
strongest!! What an amazing race!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac was so close, too~!! Those two 
really are the absolute best rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Two tempests that shake the era. Yet 
their fierce clash brings vibrant color to 
the world——"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Lala-san came so close, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It's a trivial matter.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That one already knows how they ought to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us return, Sister. Please prepare 
some tea and sweets."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Shall I brew something special 
today?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You idiot!! Why the hell did you lose?! 
Today was NOT the day to drop the ball!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(How pathetic...!! Dammit...!! Is this 
really how a "Queen" runs...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I haven't called out enough nonsense 
yet...!!
Lala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I lost! Today was my loss! I'll fully 
admit that much!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Man, Ai-san is seriously way too strong! 
Just how much stronger are ya plannin' to 
get?! Give us a break already!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Still—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I am DEEE-FINITELY gonna win. 
So, you'd better brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I really do love that about you, Lara!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What're you thanking me for?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I intended to give it everything I had 
today. I truly thought I could. But—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Feeling Lala's running up close made me 
realize it. 'This isn't everything yet.' 
'This wasn't my limit'...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To defeat you, today I was able to surpass 
the limits I couldn't even see before...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited right now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The more Lala wants to beat me, the more 
I—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can become even stronger than I am now! 
Because I finally realized that!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...So, thank you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: What the heck is that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Sheesh, I really respect how that's just 
so like you, Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, without even realizing it, I 
ended up playing the straight man to 
Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(“There's no such thing as limits for us,” 
she said.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how strong Ai-san gets, I'm 
gonna get even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing will change, ever. As the 
'Empress', that is."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how exciting!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete again and again, Lala. 
Because we're rivals, after all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"We are rivals. And we're the stars... who 
will brighten up the racing world from 
here on."
—Afterward, during the interview.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Great effort in the Japan Cup! It was a 
near miss, but could we get a comment on 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as expected of you, Ai-san. You 
truly ran a powerful race today as well. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Things won't go like this in the next 
race. With the pride of a 'Queen,' I 
intend to face Ai-san and everyone else 
head-on."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to my running bringing 
color to the racing world. Thank you very 
much for your support today.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! As expected of Lucky Lilac, her 
words carry such poise...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Right? Right? I've been visualizin' being 
"Queen" like crazy! Somethin' like this is 
a piece of cake!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next we'd like to ask the Trainer 
a few questions!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, you look sharp and ready too, 
Trainer! This is the critical moment!)

Even without words, I can tell. Lucky 
Lilac is counting on me to nail it with 
absolute perfection...!

"I'll nail it, without fail. As her 
partner, I'll deliver a comment that's 
smart, yet overflowing with raw 
passion――――!!!"
choice_data_list: Next time, wack will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kaaah——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You stumbled over your words, didn't 
you~? You're way too nervous, hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That was so close!!!!! I almost hit 'em 
with a full-on comeback retort!!! Pulling 
that off with a straight face is totally 
cheating!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a rare straight-man retort just 
burst out of Lucky Lilac-san.
choice_data_list:
I'm always zoning out, so you really save 
me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Acting the fool? Really now. This isn't a 
comedy routine, you know.

text_block_list.name: Laughter
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no! I gave a gentle straight-man 
comeback out of habit again!! And why did 
that actually get a few chuckles?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (......Well, even so—)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, the two of you make such a 
well-coordinated duo!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Well, as long as they think we're close 
friends, that's fine by me.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Even after that, they occasionally 
engaged in witty banter like a comedy duo, 
revealing the undeniable bond between 
them"......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it literally says "Comedy Duo" right 
there!
choice_data_list:
Sorry, Luck! It wasn't supposed to be like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine! I was kinda jumping in 
with some low-key comebacks here and there 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I suppose it goes both ways... It 
must've just become second nature to us 
over all the time we've spent together up 
until today."
choice_data_list:
Wearing mostly white clothes came back to 
bite me...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talkin' about stains standing 
out!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's what I'm talkin' about!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep doing things our own way from 
here on out... I'll be countin' on ya."

The days of taking on challenges with my 
partner, Lucky Lilac, are far from over—
